summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision letter granting an exception to continue listing, subject to interim milestones and compliance with Bid Price and Equity Rules by July 6, 2026. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, activist campaign, or strategic review is indicated. The company must satisfy Nasdaq requirements to avoid delisting; risk of failure to comply. No special-situation event.
